All time values here are captured GPU-event duration sums, not E2E latency or speedup. Profiled wall times were not used as performance results.
FP8 GEMM attribution separates DiT, TE language, TE vision and other/unassigned. Eligible Linear counts alone were not treated as actual GEMM evidence.
Selective preserves DiT blocks 0,1,30,31; trace independently checks 140 FP8 GEMMs per step, while exact protected module identities come from the current GPU audit.
Current profile source applies only to the exact captured symbol with full occurrence closure; generic copy/cast kernels are not all called quantization.
Generic unresolved GEMMs outside DiT/TE remain unresolved; no claim that every whole-model operation was proven BF16.
Export-only adapter skips CPU aggregation hooks; original profiler.stop, Chrome/gzip export, capture flags and finally memory snapshot remain. No pickle or generated-code execution during analysis.
